uci.title: UCI Phishing Websites - 30 engineered ternary features
uci.note: Several features (web_traffic, Page_Rank, Google_Index, Links_pointing_to_page, Statistical_report) depend on discontinued services (Alexa, PageRank) and cannot be recomputed live, so this model is for benchmark comparison only.

url.title: Live URL lexical - 44 features recomputed from PhiUSIIL + URL-paths URLs
url.note: Computed by backend/app/features/url_features.py from canonicalised URLs; split by registered domain so no site appears in both train and test.

split_comparison.explanation: Random splits let pages from the same registered domain land in both train and test, inflating scores.

sanity_suite.note: Hand-picked illustrative URLs (not used for training or selection).

content.title: Live HTML content - 24 PhiUSIIL HTML features reproducible from a fetched page
content.note: Same column definitions as PhiUSIIL, recomputed live by backend/app/features/html_features.py.

split_comparison.explanation: Random splits let pages from the same registered domain land in both train and test, inflating scores.

ablation_without_size_features.explanation: PhiUSIIL legitimate pages are full homepages while phishing pages are small kits; page-size counts alone nearly separate the classes. Removing them shows how much signal remains.

config.tuning: Optuna TPE, 3-fold CV on a stratified sample
